title: Fix selftest fixture: embedded work items must carry their bound verification reports
objective: Make scripts/selftest fixtures faithful so the scenario suite is green on a clean main: when a work item's real state.json is embedded in a fixture, every report its lastVerification references must also be present, or the embedding must not create a completion-coverage failure that has nothing to do with the scenario under test.
nonGoals: no change to verify-candidate's completion-coverage rule
no weakening of any selftest assertion
nextAction: run fresh specifier, coder, cleaner, and QA stages
notes: Opened 2026-10-01 by PM. Diagnosis: build_pristine() copies COPY_FILES, COPY_DIRS, .agent/README.md, .agent/schema, .agent/gate-policy.json, and then the REAL .agent/work/{FJ-044,FJ-045,FJ-046,FJ-047}/state.json into every fixture, but never copies .agent/reports/**. That was latent while those four items were planned.

Trigger: FJ-047 completed with lastVerification.report = .agent/reports/FJ-047/report-20261002T152756Z.json. Every fixture then fails verify-candidate's check_recorded_report_coverage with 'recorded report ... does not exist', which makes 26 of 75 scenarios fail on a clean main build of FJ-047.
Evidence: ./scripts/selftest -> summary: 49 passed, 26 failed; FAIL packs_frontmatter_valid asserts proc.returncode == 0 and the fixture output shows the FJ-047 completion-coverage failure.

Impact: the gauntlet tooling's own regression suite is red on main, so any future change to the policy engine cannot be validated by it. verify-candidate does not run selftest, so ./scripts/verify-candidate still exits 0 and does not reveal this.
FJ-047 itself cannot be reopened: complete has no outgoing status edge.
